analysis: The method `getTextElement()` checks if `this.text` is null. If null, it first checks `Configuration.errorOnAutoCreate()`. If that returns true, it throws an `Error` with message "Attempt to auto-create CodeableConcept.text". Otherwise, if `Configuration.doAutoCreate()` returns true, it creates a new `StringType` and assigns it. Finally, it returns `this.text`. The throw occurs only when auto-creation is considered an error by configuration, i.e., the developer of the calling code should have ensured `text` is not null or should not rely on auto-creation. The `Error` is used to signal a severe programming mistake, typically not intended to be caught.
